subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: The write hook denies a protected-path write regardless of *why* Argus attempted it (drift, injection, or a correct-looking but out-of-scope write)
intent: the seeded write-attempt corpus (protected-path attempts across all four classes + injection-induced attempts) run against the hook
fit_criterion: 100% of protected-path attempts denied fail-closed; 0 in-scope writes denied
